mapper.select: select id, student_id, template_id, effective_start_time, effective_end_time, status, created_at, updated_at from stu_student_permission_template where student_id = #{studentId} order by id desc
mapper.update: update stu_student_permission_template set status = 0, updated_at = now() where student_id = #{studentId} and status = 1
